objective: Model the epistemic state of generated output correctly so that a provenance record can never imply durable possession of an artifact when WRASAL only possesses an expiring provider reference. Formalize six artifact reference classes, a six-rung evidence ladder, and ProviderBinding as a first-class entity joining IdentitySnapshot to a provider subject id, without redesigning WRAYVE, without adding a provider, and without building an archival downloader.
success_condition: The possession invariant is enforced in code and refuses a false-possession record at the outbound boundary; all six reference classes and all six evidence-ladder rungs are modelled with distinct, test-asserted burdens; ProviderBinding exists as an append-only entity whose status can only reach VERIFIED with an evidence reference; a local simulated run reaches ARCHIVED while a documented provider run cannot exceed EXECUTED, and that contrast is visible in the console; the architecture regression still passes with the core domain naming no provider.

references.origin_finding: WRASAL-0013 established that the documented provider output URL is presigned and expiring

evidence.observed_result: assertNoFalsePossessionClaim() refuses four distinct classes of false record: possession asserted without a granting reference class, an evidence level above the class ceiling, ARCHIVED claimed without a content hash, and an EXPIRING reference claimed as possession. It is called before any Freebuff payload is emitted.

All six reference classes are modelled with explicit possession, durability, possession flag, evidence ceiling and an operator-readable statement. The possession flag is test-asserted to follow the possession level, so no class can silently claim bytes it does not hold.

UNKNOWN to DOCUMENTED to OBSERVED to EXECUTED to VERIFIED to ARCHIVED, each rung carrying a distinct cumulative burden from OBSERVED upward. claim() returns the highest fully-satisfied rung and names what is missing for the next.

The first implementation made documentation_reference a cumulative prerequisite for every higher rung, which meant a live observed response could not be credited unless someone had also filed a documentation reference. That ranked 'the docs say so' above 'we watched it happen', inverting the ladder's purpose. The test caught it; DOCUMENTED was moved off the cumulative chain as a weaker, different KIND of evidence.

ProviderBinding exists as an append-only entity joining IdentitySnapshot to {provider, provider_object_type, provider_subject_id} with status DECLARED, VERIFIED or REVOKED. verifyProviderBinding() refuses to promote to VERIFIED without an evidence_ref. declareProviderBinding() refuses a missing provider_subject_id rather than inventing one. Revocation appends rather than deletes; the chain stays intact.

HEYGEN_AVATAR_ID and HEYGEN_VOICE_ID bootstrap DECLARED bindings only. An environment variable is an operator assertion and can never, by itself, produce a VERIFIED binding. config.js remains the only non-adapter file permitted to name a provider, because its job is to name environment variables.

A local simulated run reaches ARCHIVED with a sha256 content hash because WRASAL wrote and hashed the bytes itself. A completed provider run returning a presigned URL is capped at EXECUTED with possession NONE, durability EXPIRING and a null content hash. Possession is demonstrated to be a separate claim from authenticity: the archived artefact is still labelled SIMULATED.

Freebuff payload raised to wrasal.freebuff.record/v0.2 carrying artifact_custody {reference_class, possession, durability, wrasal_holds_artifact, content_hash, expires_at, statement} and evidence {level, burden_met, ceiling_for_reference_class, missing_for_next_level, simulated}. Still mode SIMULATED, certified false. The custody statement spells out, when WRASAL does not hold the artefact, that the record evidences a generation occurred and does not guarantee retrievability.

node --test over the suite: 56 tests, 56 pass, 0 fail, up from 37. The §28 architecture regression remains green and caught a HeyGen mention that had leaked into a core doc comment during this work order.
No archival downloader was built. No provider was added. No credential was fabricated. No binding was marked VERIFIED. The work order models the epistemic state and stops there, as instructed.

canonical_state_impact.possession_model: new — six artifact reference classes (PROVIDER_REFERENCE, PRESIGNED_REFERENCE, DURABLE_ARTIFACT, CONTENT_HASH, ARCHIVED_ARTIFACT, ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE) each carrying explicit possession, durability and an evidence ceiling
canonical_state_impact.evidence_model: new — six-rung ladder UNKNOWN → DOCUMENTED → OBSERVED → EXECUTED → VERIFIED → ARCHIVED with cumulative burdens from OBSERVED upward; DOCUMENTED deliberately off the cumulative chain as a weaker kind of evidence
canonical_state_impact.invariant_enforced: an evidence record can no longer imply durable possession when WRASAL holds only an expiring provider reference; refused at the outbound Freebuff boundary with FALSE_POSSESSION_CLAIM
canonical_state_impact.identity_model: ProviderBinding added as a first-class append-only entity joining IdentitySnapshot to a provider subject id; Canonical Identity, Representation Identity and Provider Identity are now three distinct records and are never collapsed
canonical_state_impact.wrayve_domain_model: otherwise unchanged — Identity, IdentitySnapshot, LikenessPolicy, SceneSpec, AuthorityCheck, Approval, ExecutionRequest, Provenance and the adapter interface were not redesigned
canonical_state_impact.generation_event_fields_added: artifact (full custody record) and provider_binding; output_reference_durability retained from WRASAL-0013
canonical_state_impact.freebuff_schema: raised from wrasal.freebuff.record/v0.1 to v0.2 with artifact_custody and evidence blocks; still mode SIMULATED, certified false
canonical_state_impact.ui_surface: Identity screen gains a provider-bindings table with DECLARED/VERIFIED/REVOKED status; Provenance screen gains an artefact-custody panel that banners an expiring reference as not-possessed
canonical_state_impact.heygen_status: unchanged — still an adapter, still DOCUMENTED_NOT_OBSERVED, still no credential and no verified binding
canonical_state_impact.canonical_acceptance_promotion: WRASAL-0013 promoted to accepted via decisions/WRASAL-0013-ACCEPTANCE.md; WRASAL-0014 itself accepted 2026-10-07 via decisions/WRASAL-0014-ACCEPTANCE.md, and deliberately NOT amended in light of the infrastructure weakness WRASAL-0015 later exposed

next_candidate: WRASAL-0015 — artifact retention: given that the epistemic model is now correct, decide and implement what WRASAL actually does about expiring references (retrieve-and-archive policy, retention windows, re-verification of ARCHIVED artefacts against their hashes).
